components.name: Button
components.summary: Use for actions. variant="solid" (default) is the primary action: pink fill, white text, and on hover a white fill with pink-deep text.

components.name: Badge
components.summary: Use for short tags such as genres, stars and status.

components.name: Card
components.summary: Use for items in a listing, such as shows, characters and actors.

components.name: Field
components.summary: Use for text, email, search, number, select and textarea input.

components.name: Alert
components.summary: Use to tell people something about the page or an action.

components.name: ScoreMeter
components.summary: Use to show a show's score out of 100 (lezshows_the_score).
